newsitem.title: ALBANIA: 22 people killed in explosion in northern Albania.
newsitem.headline: 22 people killed in explosion in northern Albania.

text.p: An explosion at a weapons depot in the central Albanian town of Burrel killed 22 people on Wednesday, a government spokesman said.
The cause of the explosion was not immediately known. The depot at Burell, some 35 kms (20 miles) northeast of Tirana, was underground like many others in Albania and is located in a mining area.
Spokesman Jorgji Kote said defence and interior ministry officials had gone to the area because there was a danger of explosions at two other depots nearby, without elaborating.
Ammunition and weapons are stored underground in many Albanian military depots.
Twenty people were injured last week when an arms depot in the northern district of Lezhe exploded as youths tried to steal explosives.

Over 300 Albanians have been killed and hundreds more injured by stray bullets and explosions during a wave of violence that engulfed the country following the wholesale looting of arms depots by civilians earlier this year.
